summary_md: **(((JReuben1))) ([@jreuben1](https://x.com/jreuben1/status/2116423944806842462))** shares **Xolotl**, a fork of Strata-DSV4.1 that runs all 552B of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as a local coding agent on an RTX 4090 with 90 GB RAM at up to about 27 tok/s and 512K context. MoE experts are tiered across VRAM, RAM and NVMe, and it also supports GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8 ([Indras-Mirror/Xolotl](https://github.com/Indras-Mirror/Xolotl)).
